title: Digital Finance User Experience (UX) Manager
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

**Digital Finance User Experience (UX) Manager**

**Description**

The Digital Finance UX Manager is responsible for enhancing the user experience across finance systems, digital tools, and workflows. The role ensures finance technology solutions are intuitive, efficient, and drive high user adoption by partnering with Finance, Technology, and Product teams.

  

**Job specification**

* Design and improve user journeys across finance processes including planning, reporting, accounting, and forecasting.

* Conduct user research, gather feedback, and identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve usability.

* Partner with Product Owners and Technology teams to translate business requirements into user-centric solutions.

* Develop wireframes, process maps, and experience recommendations for finance platforms.

* Support user acceptance testing (UAT), training, and change management activities.

* Monitor system adoption, user satisfaction, and experience metrics, driving continuous improvements.

* Establish UX standards and best practices across digital finance products.

  

**Skills Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, UX Design, or a related discipline.

* UX, Design Thinking, Agile, or Change Management certifications preferred.

* Understands the business and its challenges, and can translate business needs into HR solutions.
* 5+ years' experience in UX, Digital Transformation, Product Design, Business Analysis, or Finance Transformation.

* Strong understanding of finance processes and enterprise systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, Anaplan, OneStream, etc.).

* Experience with UX tools such as Figma or Adobe XD.

* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

* Experience working in Agile environments.
  

  
  

**What you will get in return:**

* A genuinely unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business;
* Competitive remuneration commensurate with skills and experience;
  

  

**Additional information:** We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.We measure our success as a business, not only by delivering great products and services and continually increasing our assets under administration and market share, but also by how we positively impact people, society and the planet.For more information on our commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) please https://www.apexgroup.com/corporate-social-responsibility/

  
  

We pride ourselves in our commitment to fostering a connected and inclusive culture, all our opportunities at Apex have four (4) days in office requirement.

  
  

Disclaimer : Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

title: Interior Designer & 3D Visualizer
description:
Job Title: Interior Designer & 3D VisualizerDepartment: 3D Visualization & VR DevelopmentIndustry: Architecture, Interior Design & Virtual Reality

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and technically skilled Interior Designer & 3D Visualizer who can handle complete project development, including architectural layout development, landscape and amenity layouts, interior design, 3D modelling, and realistic visualization. The candidate will be responsible for converting architectural drawings and references into detailed 3D models and preparing them for immersive VR walkthroughs using Enscape and D5 Render.

Key Responsibilities

1. Layout Development & Space Planning

* Develop complete architectural layouts using SketchUp and other relevant software.
* Understand and interpret CAD drawings, architectural plans, and client requirements.
* Develop site layouts, landscape layouts, amenity areas, pathways, roads, and outdoor spaces.
* Plan furniture arrangements, circulation, and space utilization.
* Ensure accurate dimensions and proper coordination between architectural and landscape elements.

2. Interior Design & Development

* Develop interior concepts and detailed 3D interior models.
* Design residential apartments, villas, clubhouses, and commercial interiors.
* Work on furniture layouts, ceiling designs, flooring, wall finishes, and interior detailing.
* Select appropriate materials, textures, colours, furniture, and lighting based on design references.
* Implement design modifications based on client feedback.

3. 3D Modelling & Visualization

* Develop detailed 3D models using SketchUp and 3ds Max.
* Create architectural elements, furniture, landscape assets, and interior components.
* Apply realistic materials, textures, and lighting.
* Maintain modelling accuracy and quality throughout project development.
* Optimize 3D models for real-time rendering and VR applications.

4. Rendering & VR Walkthrough Development

* Work extensively with Enscape and D5 Render for real-time rendering.
* Set up realistic lighting, materials, camera views, and environmental settings.
* Develop high-quality interior and exterior renders.
* Prepare 3D models for immersive VR walkthroughs.
* Capture required views, including interior views, balcony views, landscape views, and amenity views.
* Ensure the final output meets visualization and platform requirements.

5. Project Coordination & Execution

* Coordinate with architects, project managers, and the VR development team.
* Understand project requirements and implement client inputs.
* Follow project schedules and complete assigned deliverables within deadlines.
* Maintain organized project files, linked textures, and assets.
* Ensure quality checks before final project handover.

Required Technical Skills

* SketchUp: Layout development, 3D modelling, and space planning.
* 3ds Max: Detailed 3D modelling and interior development.
* D5 Render: Real-time rendering, lighting, materials, and walkthroughs.
* Enscape: Real-time visualization and VR walkthrough preparation.
* AutoCAD: Reading and understanding architectural drawings.
* Good understanding of interior design, landscape development, and architectural visualization.
* Knowledge of materials, textures, lighting, furniture, and landscaping.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in architectural visualization, interior design, or VR development is preferred.

Expected Project Deliverables

* Complete architectural and landscape layout development.
* Detailed 3D modelling of buildings and amenities.
* Interior design and furniture development.
* Material, texture, and lighting application.
* High-quality renders using Enscape and D5 Render.
* VR-ready 3D models and walkthrough scenes.
* Final project files with proper organization and handover.

Key Performance Expectations

* Accuracy and quality of layout development.
* Creativity in interior and landscape design.
* Quality and detailing of 3D models.
* Realistic rendering and visualization output.
* Ability to prepare models for VR walkthroughs.
* Timely completion of assigned project tasks.
* Ability to understand and implement client requirements.

Pay: ₹28,000.00 - ₹32,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided

Work Location: In person

title: Visual / UI Designer
description:
**About the company**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders. We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our engineering team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in.

**About the role**

As a Visual / UI Designer at Keka, you’ll lead the visual side of Keka’s UI upgrade across web and mobile. You’ll take existing screens and new designs and turn them into polished, balanced and consistent experiences that feel unmistakably Keka. You’ll work closely with Product Designers, the Design System team and Frontend Engineers to refine layout, hierarchy, spacing, typography and visual details across the product. Success means creating high-quality interfaces that are clear, accessible, responsive and consistent, while building a visual system that can scale across Keka’s growing product.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead the visual work on UI upgrade projects by auditing existing screens, identifying visual inconsistencies and redesigning them module by module
* Take wireframes and flows from Product Designers and turn them into high-fidelity screens with clear hierarchy, consistent spacing, strong alignment and visual balance
* Own Keka’s visual language across colour, typography, spacing, iconography, illustration and elevation, applying it consistently across web and mobile
* Design high-fidelity UI for new features and redesigns across every important state, including empty, loading, error, success and permission states
* Build and maintain design system components in Figma, including variants, variables, tokens and documentation that engineers can implement directly
* Design micro-interactions, motion and moments of delight that feel human while remaining performant on low-end devices and slower networks
* Design accessible experiences aligned with WCAG 2.1 AA, including appropriate contrast, touch targets, readable typography and layouts that work well for frontline and blue-collar employees using smaller Android devices
* Design interfaces that work across languages and countries, accounting for longer translated text, different number and date formats and right-to-left languages
* Partner closely with Frontend Engineers to ensure what ships matches the design and review builds before release
* Use AI tools in your workflow for exploring options, generating assets and prototyping while maintaining strong design judgement and quality standards
* Contribute to marketing and brand touchpoints when required, including product screenshots, launch visuals and in-app announcements

**What you’ll bring**

  

* 3 to 6 years of experience designing digital product UI, with shipped work in SaaS, B2B or complex web products
* Strong visual craft across hierarchy, typography, colour, alignment, spacing and visual balance, with the ability to identify and resolve visual issues in dense interfaces
* Advanced Figma skills, including auto layout, components, variants, variables, tokens and well organized files that other designers can easily work with
* Hands-on design system experience, including building or maintaining components rather than only using existing systems
* Experience designing dense, data-heavy interfaces such as tables, forms, dashboards and settings without compromising clarity or information density
* Working knowledge of accessibility and how designs translate into production, including responsive layouts, interaction states and understanding of implementation constraints
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly to Product Managers, Designers and Engineers and work effectively through feedback
* A distinct visual point of view and the ability to bring original thinking rather than copying patterns from popular products
* Experience designing across multiple screen sizes and platforms, with a strong understanding of responsive behavior and mobile interfaces

**Nice to have**

  

* Motion design experience using tools such as Lottie, Rive or Figma prototyping, with an understanding of performance considerations
* Icon or illustration design experience, including building or extending an icon set
* Experience with design tokens and design-to-code workflows, including familiarity with HTML/CSS or React
* Experience designing for HR, payroll, fintech or other enterprise products
* Experience designing for mobile-first or low-literacy users, or products used across multiple languages and countries

**What your portfolio should show**

* At least one before-and-after redesign of an existing product, showing what you changed and why
* The options and trade-offs you explored and the reasoning behind the final direction
* Attention to details such as states, edge cases, responsive behavior and accessibility, not only the primary or hero screen
* Evidence of system thinking through components, tokens or

title: Visual / Motion Designer
description:
**About the role**

As a Visual / Motion Designer at Keka, you’ll help define how motion and visual feedback work across a product used every day by thousands of employees and HR teams. You’ll build the first motion language for Keka, making interactions feel clear, confident and intentional rather than decorative. You’ll work closely with the Design System and Product teams to establish motion foundations, interaction states and visual patterns that can scale across the product. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you’ll shape the systems, patterns and standards that make the product easier to understand and use.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Build Keka’s motion foundations, including duration, easing, choreography, performance budgets and reduced-motion principles
* Own feedback, loading and confirmation patterns across the product so users always understand what just happened and what is about to happen
* Co-own the interaction state model with the Design System Lead and establish reusable patterns that can scale across products
* Design empty states, first-run experiences and brand-in-product surfaces that make complex enterprise workflows feel clearer and more human
* Bring motion into Keka’s AI surfaces, particularly where communicating wait time, progress and system behavior is important to the user experience
* Define the visual side of accessibility, including contrast, focus visibility and avoiding colour only communication
* Partner closely with engineers to ensure motion and interaction systems are practical, performant and shipped to production.

**What you’ll bring**

  

* 2 to 4 years of experience designing motion and visual experiences for software products
* Strong experience with product motion, including transitions, interaction states and micro-interactions; this is not a film or brand-motion role
* A portfolio demonstrating motion that has been shipped to production, not only explored through prototypes
* Strong visual craft across typography, colour, spacing, hierarchy and composition
* The ability to think in systems and establish reusable rules rather than solving individual screens in isolation
* Ability to clearly specify motion for engineers, including duration, easing, trigger, entry and exit behavior
* Strong understanding of accessibility as part of product craft, not just compliance
* Experience working with modern motion and interaction tools such as Framer Motion, Rive, Lottie or CSS is a plus

description:

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.
  
  
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
As a Principal Layout Designer (10+ years of experience in layout)
  
  
You must have the ability to understand design constraints and implement high-quality layouts.
  
You must be proficient using Cadence VXL on periphery blocks.
  
You must have strong debug and problem-solving skills for LVS, DRC & Layout issues.
  
You must have hands-on experience in creating layout of critical Core/Pitch blocks such as Array, Row decoder & Column Decoder.
  
You must have good understanding of Core/Pitch Layout fundamentals such as BL & WL pitch, and a feasibility acumen for developing WL & BL drivers & pre-drivers.
  
You must have good experience of Chip Level Integration and Die Size calculations.
  
You must have a good understanding of the Design rules and deliver with quality layout.
  
You must deliver major level blocks, including signal and floorplan, to the Core/Pitch and Periphery area.
  
You will work with Design and other engineering groups to apply multiple layout techniques for the design and verification of Array, Digital and Analog circuits.
  
You must execute secondary layout tasks such as ECO, LCO and DFM.
  
You will be responsible for coordinating with TD, Design, CAD and layout teams to deliver on schedule with quality.
  
You must demonstrate a strong ability to debug problems, find effective solutions, and negotiate with the engineering staff. You will be required to meet all engineering and process related criteria needed for an assigned NAND product.
  
You will organize and prioritize logistics and resource allocations to meet scheduled deadlines and proactively develop methodologies for issue resolution.
  
You will be expected to understand various circuit design protocols, different fab processes, mask generation techniques, and tape-out processes and procedures.
  
You should be able to mentor Junior team members.
  
You must drive innovation into the future Memory generations within a dynamic work environment.
  
Multiple Tape out support experience will be an added advantage.
  
You must have a good understanding of automation and leveraging AI tool proficiency to enable your work.

title: Digital Consumer Experience (CX) Designer, R&D
description:
**About the Team**

We are an innovative global healthcare company driven by one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. With a presence in more than 100 countries, our teams are dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine and turning the impossible into the possible.

Sanofi is on an ambitious digital transformation journey, accelerating data-driven innovation and the adoption of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning across R&D, manufacturing, and commercial operations.

As a CX Designer within Digital R&D, you will help shape intuitive, effective digital experiences that support this transformation. You will work as part of a global Consumer Experience (CX) team and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and business stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization.

**About You**

* You are a product designer who combines strong interaction and visual design skills with sound product judgment.
* You are comfortable working in an environment where requirements may not always arrive fully defined. You know how to ask the right questions, identify what information is missing, create structure from ambiguity, and move work forward without waiting for every detail to be provided.
* You bring a design point of view to the table rather than simply executing requirements. You can translate business and user needs into clear experience recommendations, communicate the rationale behind your decisions, and work constructively with Product and Engineering to refine solutions.
* You are organized, proactive, and reliable. You communicate clearly, manage priorities effectively, follow through on commitments, and raise risks or changes early.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own product design work from problem definition through detailed design and development handoff.
* Partner with Product to understand the business problem, user needs, constraints, and desired outcomes, then develop and recommend appropriate experience solutions.
* Conduct lightweight research, competitive review, benchmarking, and design exploration as needed to inform decisions.
* Create clear information architecture, user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that show how the overall experience fits together.
* Balance product-level thinking with attention to interaction, visual design, content, edge cases, and error states.
* Work iteratively with Product and Engineering, sharing work early, incorporating feedback, and refining solutions rather than waiting for perfect inputs.
* Clearly communicate design recommendations, decisions, Progress, risks, and next steps in meetings and written documentation.
* Prioritize effectively across competing requests and stay focused on agreed product and delivery priorities.
* Maintain design documentation and specifications that are clear enough for Product, Engineering, and other designers to use.
* Participate actively in Agile ways of working, including planning, reviews, demos, and cross-functional discussions.
* Apply and contribute to Sanofi design systems, standards, and the One Sanofi Experience.
* Use AI-enabled design and prototyping tools thoughtfully to accelerate exploration and execution while applying independent design judgment to the final outcome.
* Build productive working relationships across global and local teams and contribute to a collaborative design culture.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Design, HCI, or related field.
* 3+ years of product, UX, or interaction design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating your design process and shipped digital products.
* Strong product design fundamentals, including interaction design, information architecture, user flows, prototyping, and visual design.
* Demonstrated ability to work through complex or ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, actionable design solutions.
* Ability to work independently while knowing when to seek input, alignment, or support.
* Experience partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain design decisions clearly and concisely.
* Strong prioritization, organization, and follow-through across multiple workstreams.

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by **Mr. Alan S. McKim**.

title: Senior UX Designer, Design
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Business stands at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. The Amazon Business User Experience team champions the business customer in the Amazon Marketplace and supports procurement elements for Amazon Business customers. Areas that a Senior UX Designer in AB team will support include partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver costumer-centric solutions for admins involved in business procurement for all sizes of businesses. You will work with the foundational services team to enhance the account management tools in the account configuration and analytics space.
  
  
A Senior UX Designer in this organization works on the tactical and strategic. They determine the strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome. They will drive the use of best practices and learn to influence and force multiply. This role needs to be capable of operating autonomously in partnering with product stakeholders from the enterprise account management team to research, define requirements and realize solutions for complex problems across the end-to-end account admins experience. This role will be instrumental in defining the agentic experiences leveraging latest AI technologies.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Senior UX Designer's role is to facilitate process where there is ambiguity in product strategy, product requirements, and technical feasibility. They will be expected to pull insights, guide product stakeholders into design exercises and activities to shape and prioritize user stories ahead of designing solutions. This role must be able to recognize risks and effectively communicate and escalate issues that may impact the customer experience, then help to arrive at solutions that are acceptable to cross-functional stakeholders - be it peers or skip-level. This role is a key contributor to generating design documents that succinctly communicate recommendations, limitations, trade-offs and product direction to leaders across the org. This role must be able to articulate potential consequences of short-term solutions that may negatively impact customers. Where there are opportunities, a Senior UX Designer must propose optimal long-term solutions as methods of inventing and simplifying for the greatest impact in delivery. This role will be instrumental in helping to inform and shape product roadmaps, business goals, objectives and metrics that all add customer value.  
  
A day in the life  
The Senior UX Designer is a vocal advocate for the customer, and they will work on multiple initiatives concurrently. This role operates as an ambassador for best practices, impactful trends, and continually innovates on released features. This role will be a highly visible team player through their ability to pull stakeholders together to collaborate. As a Sr. UX designer and champion of people, their mentoring will include critiquing, providing design feedback, conducting retros & research that can influence engineering team decisions to enable optimal solutions for our customers.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of UX designer or interaction designer experience
* Have an online portfolio or samples of work on resume, demonstrating experience creating great end-to-end, user-centered design solutions and patterns, across desktop and mobile devices
* Experience in delivering design solutions for projects of large scope and complexity
* Experience working with stakeholders to plan and execute programs that are strategic in nature
* Experience using customer insights and data to deeply understand target customers and dive deep
* Experience in a variety of design, wire-framing, and prototyping tools

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience applying scrum to visual or UX design processes
* Master's degree or equivalent in design, human-computer interaction (HCI), or Master's degree
* Experience in B2B, high-tech products/services preferred
* Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale

title: Interior Designer
description:
About the Role

Benaka Healthcare is looking for a **detail\-oriented Interior Designer** to support our **turnkey hospital and healthcare infrastructure projects**. You will be responsible for developing interior design concepts, detailed drawings, and specifications that translate clinical requirements into functional, safe, and aesthetically pleasing healthcare environments.

You will play a critical role in shaping **patient areas, clinical spaces, and staff environments**, ensuring designs are practical, compliant with healthcare standards, and seamlessly executed on site for hospitals, diagnostic centres, and modular OT projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop **interior design layouts and detailed drawings** for hospital spaces including OPDs, patient rooms, ICUs, waiting areas, nursing stations, diagnostics, and administrative areas.
* Prepare **interior working drawings** such as furniture layouts, ceiling plans, lighting layouts, flooring patterns, wall finishes, and joinery details.
* Coordinate interior designs with **architectural and MEP layouts** to ensure clash\-free execution.
* Assist in designing interiors for **modular OTs, recovery rooms, and sterile zones** as per hospital norms.
* Select and specify **materials, finishes, colours, and fixtures** suitable for healthcare environments (durability, hygiene, safety).
* Revise drawings and designs based on **site conditions, client feedback, and project updates**.
* Work closely with architects, engineers, vendors, and the execution team to ensure designs are **buildable and executed as intended**.
* Ensure interior designs comply with **healthcare standards and guidelines** (NABH, NBC, fire safety, infection control norms).
* Support **BOQ preparation**, vendor coordination, and material finalisation where required.
* Maintain proper **drawing documentation, version control, and approvals** throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements

* Diploma or Degree in **Interior Design / Architecture**.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD (2D mandatory)**; knowledge of SketchUp, 3D tools, or rendering software is an advantage.
* Prior experience in **hospital, healthcare, or commercial interior projects** preferred.
* Understanding of **healthcare interior planning**, material selection, and hygiene\-focused design.
* Basic knowledge of **MEP coordination and on\-site execution processes**.
* Ability to read architectural, structural, and services drawings.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and time management.
* Good communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, consultants, and vendors.

Why Join Benaka Projects?

* Work on **meaningful healthcare projects** that directly impact patient care and outcomes.
* Exposure to **end\-to\-end turnkey execution** of hospitals and diagnostic facilities.
* Opportunity to grow with a company shaping **modern healthcare spaces across India**.
* Collaborative environment with hands\-on learning and real\-world project responsibility.
